
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- 03_touch_esp32_only.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- 03_touch_esp32_only.volt:4[/red bold]

ESP8266 does not have capacitive touch pins.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin t: Touch = 4
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Capacitive touch is available on ESP32.[/cyan]
